nodes.summary: The Dursleys insist they are perfectly normal, oblivious to the strange people gathering across Britain.

dialogue.line: Perfectly normal people, that's us. Nothing strange going on here.
I saw that Potter woman's cat again, prowling by the fence.

nodes.summary: Owls fly by daylight and strangely dressed people whisper in the streets; Vernon senses something is wrong.

dialogue.line: Owls in broad daylight? People in cloaks whispering the name Potter?
It can't have anything to do with us.

nodes.summary: Dumbledore meets Professor McGonagall, who has been watching the Dursleys all day as a cat, to discuss Voldemort's sudden fall.

dialogue.line: Is it true, Albus? Has he really gone at last?
It certainly seems so. We have much to be thankful for.
But why leave Harry with these people? They're nothing like us.

nodes.summary: Hagrid arrives on a flying motorcycle carrying baby Harry, rescued from the ruins of the Potters' house.

dialogue.line: No problems, sir. House was almost destroyed, but I got him out safe.
Well done, Hagrid. Give him here — we'd better get this over with.

nodes.summary: Dumbledore leaves baby Harry, with a letter tucked in his blankets, on the Dursleys' doorstep and disappears into the night.

dialogue.line: Good luck, Harry.
I'll be taking Sirius's bike back — g'night, Professor.

nodes.summary: Ten years on, Harry is woken in his cupboard under the stairs by Aunt Petunia's shrieking on Dudley's birthday.

dialogue.line: Up! Get up, now! I want everything perfect for Duddy's birthday.
Nearly.

nodes.summary: Dudley counts his mountain of presents and throws a tantrum over the total, while Harry cooks breakfast.

dialogue.line: Thirty-six? That's two less than last year!
We'll buy you two more presents while we're out today, popkin.

nodes.summary: Mrs. Figg has broken her leg and can't take Harry, so the Dursleys reluctantly bring him along to the zoo.

dialogue.line: Bad news, Vernon — Mrs. Figg's broken her leg. She can't take him.
I'm warning you, boy — any funny business and it's the cupboard till Christmas.

nodes.summary: Harry has a strange conversation with a boa constrictor, and when Dudley shoves him aside the glass vanishes, letting the snake loose.

dialogue.line: I know — it must be really annoying, everyone drumming on the glass.
Out of the way, you!
I didn't do anything — the glass was just there and then it wasn't!

nodes.summary: Uncle Vernon, furious and certain Harry is to blame, locks him in the cupboard without meals.

dialogue.line: Go — cupboard — stay — no meals.
I'm not going to do anything, honestly.

nodes.summary: A letter addressed precisely to Harry's cupboard arrives; Uncle Vernon snatches it away before Harry can open it.

dialogue.line: That's mine — give it back!
Who'd be writing to you?

nodes.summary: Vernon boards up the mail slot and burns every letter that arrives, insisting the family will simply ignore them.

dialogue.line: If they don't get an answer, they'll just give up.
I'm not sure that'll work, Vernon.

nodes.summary: Dozens of letters pour down the chimney like bullets; a terrified Vernon declares the family is going away.

dialogue.line: That does it — pack some clothes, we're leaving, no arguments!
Daddy's gone mad, hasn't he?

nodes.summary: After days of driving in circles, Vernon rows the family out to a miserable shack on a sea rock, sure no letter can follow them there.

dialogue.line: Found the perfect place! Storm forecast for tonight — no post reaches us here.
Tomorrow's my birthday.

nodes.summary: At midnight on Harry's birthday, Hagrid smashes down the door, brushing off Vernon's rifle and demanding tea.

dialogue.line: I warn you — I'm armed!
Couldn't make us a cup o' tea, could yeh? Not been an easy journey.
Yeh look a lot like yer dad, but yeh've got yer mum's eyes.

nodes.summary: Hagrid announces that Harry is a wizard accepted to Hogwarts, over Vernon's furious objections.

dialogue.line: Harry — yer a wizard.
He's not going, and that's final!
A great Muggle like you won't stop Lily and James's son going to Hogwarts.

nodes.summary: Hagrid tells Harry the truth about his parents' murder and how he alone survived Voldemort's curse as a baby.

dialogue.line: Yer mum and dad didn't die in a car crash — they were killed.
But why? What happened?
No one knows why you survived, Harry. But that's why yer famous.

nodes.summary: Harry finally reads his acceptance letter by firelight while Hagrid mends a torn Ministry note with an owl.

dialogue.line: We are pleased to inform you that you have been accepted at Hogwarts.
Course yeh are. Best be off tomorrow — lots ter buy in London.

nodes.summary: Hagrid takes Harry to Gringotts, where Harry discovers his parents left him a small fortune, and Hagrid secretly empties a mysterious vault.

dialogue.line: Yeh didn't think yer parents left yeh nothing, did yeh?
Wizards have banks?

nodes.summary: Harry wanders wide-eyed through Diagon Alley buying his school supplies and learns just how famous his name is.

dialogue.line: Everyone in our world knows your name, Harry.
I don't understand why anyone would know who I am.

nodes.summary: While being fitted for robes, Harry meets a pale, arrogant boy who sneers at Hagrid and at Muggle-born wizards.

dialogue.line: I really don't think they should let the other sort in, do you?
They were a witch and wizard, if that's what you mean.

nodes.summary: After many failed wands, the holly-and-phoenix-feather wand chooses Harry — its twin gave him his scar.

dialogue.line: What's curious about it?
So its brother gave me this scar.

nodes.summary: Harry panics when he can't find platform nine and three-quarters among the ordinary Muggle crowds.

dialogue.line: Platform nine and three-quarters — but there's nothing between nine and ten.

nodes.summary: Mrs. Weasley overhears Harry's trouble and shows him how to run straight at the barrier to reach the platform.

dialogue.line: Excuse me — I don't know how to get onto the platform.
All you have to do is walk straight at it. Best do it at a run if you're nervous.

nodes.summary: On the train, Harry shares a compartment with Ron Weasley and they swap stories about their families.

dialogue.line: Are you really Harry Potter?
I wish I'd had three wizard brothers instead of the Dursleys.

nodes.summary: Draco Malfoy visits their compartment, insults Ron's family, and Harry refuses his offered friendship.

dialogue.line: You'll soon find some wizarding families are better than others, Potter.
I can judge the wrong sort for myself, thanks.
Say that again and I'll fight you.

nodes.summary: A bossy girl named Hermione Granger barges in looking for a lost toad and lectures them on spellwork.

dialogue.line: Has anyone seen a toad? Neville's lost one.
I've learned all our course books by heart, of course.

nodes.summary: Hagrid ferries the first years across the lake, and they get their first glimpse of Hogwarts castle lit up at night.

dialogue.line: Ye'll all get yer first sight o' Hogwarts in a sec — jus' round this bend.
It's incredible.

nodes.summary: The Sorting Hat places Harry in Gryffindor, along with Ron and Hermione, while Malfoy goes to Slytherin.

dialogue.line: Not Slytherin, not Slytherin.
Welcome to a new year at Hogwarts!

nodes.summary: The new Gryffindors enjoy the start-of-term feast and meet the school's resident ghosts.

dialogue.line: Great food, isn't it?
I've never seen so much food in my life.

nodes.summary: Harry's scar burns sharply the moment Professor Snape looks his way across the High Table.

dialogue.line: Ouch!
Who's that teacher talking to Professor Quirrell?

nodes.summary: Harry and Ron struggle to find their way around Hogwarts's shifting staircases and hidden classrooms.

dialogue.line: There are a hundred and forty-two staircases and none of them stay put.
I'll never learn this place.

nodes.summary: Snape humiliates Harry in his first Potions lesson, singling him out with questions no first year could answer.

dialogue.line: Our new celebrity, Mr. Potter.
I don't know, sir.
Tut, tut — fame clearly isn't everything.

nodes.summary: Over tea, Hagrid lets slip that a three-headed dog and Nicolas Flamel are somehow connected to Snape's bad leg.

dialogue.line: Snape seemed to really hate me.
Rubbish! Why should he?
Wonder what's wrong with his leg?

nodes.summary: Malfoy challenges Harry to a midnight wizard's duel in the trophy room, with Ron as Harry's second.

dialogue.line: I'd take you on anytime. Tonight, if you want. Wizard's duel.
I'm his second — who's yours?

nodes.summary: Malfoy never shows up — it was a trick to get them caught by Filch — and fleeing the trio stumbles onto something far worse.

dialogue.line: Malfoy tricked you — he was never going to meet you.
Run!

nodes.summary: Fleeing Filch, they burst through a forbidden door and come face to face with an enormous three-headed dog standing on a trapdoor.

dialogue.line: It was standing on a trapdoor — it's guarding something.
What do they think they're doing, keeping a thing like that in a school?

nodes.summary: During flying lessons Neville is hurt and Malfoy steals his Remembrall, taunting Harry into a reckless chase.

dialogue.line: Catch it if you can, then!
Give it here, Malfoy!

nodes.summary: Professor McGonagall, astonished by the catch, makes Harry the youngest Seeker in a century for Gryffindor.

dialogue.line: I've never seen anything like it. The boy's a natural.
Seeker? But first years never —

nodes.summary: Professor Quirrell bursts into the Halloween feast shouting that a troll has gotten into the dungeons.

dialogue.line: Troll — in the dungeons — thought you ought to know.
Prefects, lead your houses back to the dormitories immediately!

nodes.summary: Realizing Hermione doesn't know about the troll, Harry and Ron find her cornered by it in the girls' bathroom.

dialogue.line: It's the girls' bathroom — Hermione!
Wingardium Leviosa!
I went looking for the troll myself, Professor — they saved me.

nodes.summary: Having faced the troll together, Harry, Ron, and Hermione become close friends for the first time.

dialogue.line: Thanks — you two really saved me back there.
Anytime.

nodes.summary: The trio panics on learning Snape will referee Harry's next Quidditch match, fearing he'll target him.

dialogue.line: Snape's refereeing? He'll be looking for any excuse to hurt Gryffindor.
Don't play, Harry.

nodes.summary: Harry's broom bucks wildly mid-match; Hermione spots Snape muttering a curse and sets his robes alight to break it.

dialogue.line: Snape's jinxing the broom — I have to stop him!
I've got the Snitch!

nodes.summary: Hagrid accidentally confirms the dog is named Fluffy and blurts out the name Nicolas Flamel before catching himself.

dialogue.line: That's between Professor Dumbledore an' Nicolas Flamel —
Aha! So there's someone called Nicolas Flamel involved, is there?

nodes.summary: On Christmas morning Harry receives an anonymous gift: his late father's invisibility cloak.

dialogue.line: I've heard of those — they're really rare and really valuable.
It was my father's.

nodes.summary: Exploring at night under the cloak, Harry finds a strange mirror that shows him his parents alive and smiling.

dialogue.line: Mom? Dad?
I'll come back.

nodes.summary: Dumbledore finds Harry before the mirror and explains it shows only the deepest desire of the heart, warning him away from it.

dialogue.line: It shows us nothing more or less than the deepest desire of our hearts.
It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.

nodes.summary: Hermione finally finds Nicolas Flamel's name in an old library book about famous wizards.

dialogue.line: I've found him! I've found Flamel!
Are we allowed to speak yet?

nodes.summary: They learn Flamel is the maker of the legendary Sorcerer's Stone, which grants gold and eternal life.

dialogue.line: Nicolas Flamel is the only known maker of the Sorcerer's Stone!
So that's what Fluffy's guarding.

nodes.summary: Harry catches another spectacular win for Gryffindor, briefly lifting the mood before winter break.

dialogue.line: Brilliant catch, Harry!
Just glad Snape wasn't reffing this one.

nodes.summary: Hagrid wins a dragon egg in a card game with a mysterious stranger who asked odd questions about Fluffy.

dialogue.line: Won it off a stranger las' night — never even saw his face.
And did he seem interested in Fluffy?

nodes.summary: The egg hatches into a baby dragon Hagrid names Norbert, growing dangerously fast in his wooden hut.

dialogue.line: Isn't he beautiful? Bless him, look, he knows his mommy!
Hagrid, you live in a wooden house.

nodes.summary: Malfoy peers through Hagrid's window and sees the dragon, giving him ammunition to threaten the trio.

dialogue.line: Wait till Dumbledore hears about this.
We have to get Norbert out of here — fast.

nodes.summary: Under the invisibility cloak, Harry and Hermione smuggle Norbert to the tallest tower to be collected by Charlie Weasley's friends.

dialogue.line: Norbert's going... going... gone.
No more dragon — now let's just hope Malfoy didn't see anything.

nodes.summary: Malfoy corners Harry to gloat, but is caught himself by McGonagall while trying to report the dragon.

dialogue.line: Harry Potter's got a dragon!
What utter rubbish! Detention, Malfoy — twenty points from Slytherin!

nodes.summary: Harry, Hermione, and Neville are caught out of bed too and are all sentenced to detention in the Forbidden Forest with Hagrid.

dialogue.line: Four students out of bed in one night! Fifty points from Gryffindor.
It's inter the forest yeh're going.

nodes.summary: Deep in the forest, Harry finds a dead unicorn and watches in horror as a hooded figure drinks its silvery blood.

dialogue.line: That's unicorn blood. There's a unicorn in there been hurt badly by summat.
What was that thing?

nodes.summary: The cloaked figure lunges at Harry, but the centaur Firenze charges in and carries him to safety.

dialogue.line: You are the Potter boy — you had better get back to Hagrid.
Can you think of no one who has waited years to return to power?

nodes.summary: Shaken by what he's seen and stripped of house points, Harry realizes Voldemort himself may be hiding in the forest.

dialogue.line: Firenze thinks the Stone's the only thing keeping him from coming back fully.
Harry, everyone says Dumbledore's the only one You-Know-Who was ever afraid of.

nodes.summary: Harry overhears Snape pressuring Quirrell about breaking a protective spell, seemingly confirming Snape is after the Stone.

dialogue.line: Have you found out how to get past Hagrid's creature yet?
I d-don't know what you mean, Severus.

nodes.summary: Believing Snape will steal the Stone that very night with Dumbledore called away, the trio decides to go after it themselves.

dialogue.line: If Snape gets the Stone, Voldemort comes back. I'm going tonight.
Then we're coming with you.

nodes.summary: Past the now-sleeping three-headed dog they fall into a pit of Devil's Snare; Hermione's fire charm frees them just in time.

dialogue.line: Are you a witch or not? Light a fire!
Of course — I wasn't thinking straight.

nodes.summary: Harry uses his Seeker instincts to chase down and catch the single key that opens the next locked door.

dialogue.line: That one — the one with the bent wing!
Brilliant, Harry!

nodes.summary: Ron directs a deadly game of life-size wizard's chess and deliberately sacrifices himself so Harry can win.

dialogue.line: I've got to be taken — that leaves you free to finish it, Harry.
Ron, no!

nodes.summary: Hermione solves a logic puzzle among seven bottles of potion; she goes back for help while Harry drinks on alone.

dialogue.line: This isn't magic, it's logic — a puzzle.
Go, get Ron, and get help. I'll hold him off.

nodes.summary: Harry finds Quirrell, not Snape, guarding the Stone — and sees Voldemort's face on the back of Quirrell's head.

dialogue.line: Next to Snape, who would suspect poor, stuttering Professor Quirrell?
Harry Potter — see what I have become.

nodes.summary: The Mirror of Erised gives Harry the Stone because he wants only to find it, not to use it.

dialogue.line: I see myself finding it — it's in my pocket.

nodes.summary: Voldemort demands the Stone through Quirrell; when Quirrell touches Harry, his mother's old protection burns him, and Harry blacks out.

dialogue.line: Give me the Stone, unless you want her to have died in vain.
Never!

nodes.summary: Harry wakes in the hospital wing; Dumbledore explains the Stone's destruction and why Voldemort could not touch him.

dialogue.line: Your mother died to save you — that love left its mark on you still.
So Voldemort's still out there somewhere.
He is — but you have delayed his return to power.

nodes.summary: Dumbledore awards last-minute points for courage; Gryffindor overtakes Slytherin to win the house cup.

dialogue.line: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our friends — ten points to Neville Longbottom.
We won!

nodes.summary: Harry heads back to the Dursleys for the summer, promising Ron and Hermione he'll see them again.

dialogue.line: You must come and stay this summer — I'll send an owl.
They don't know we're not allowed magic at home. I'm going to have some fun.
